listing.name: Dragon Ball Z: Budokai Tenkaichi 3 — BT3-Recomp (z3xox)
listing.summary: The project describes a player with a frontend and local builds from your own disc. It is separate from the Tenkaichi3Decomp project; that project’s matching source does not confirm this player. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS-21678 disc.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the project’s portable player and original-file import instructions. This guide has not confirmed the release contents or how its generated game code was produced.
